Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Data Analyst position at your company. With a degree in statistics and hands-on experience turning messy data into clear recommendations, I am excited by the chance to support your logistics operations.

During my internship at a regional distribution company, I analyzed delivery records to identify patterns behind late shipments. Using SQL and Excel, I cleaned and merged data from three sources, then built a Tableau dashboard that tracked on-time performance by route and carrier. The operations team used it in weekly meetings, and their adjustments to two problem routes reduced delays by 12 percent over the following quarter.

In my coursework, I completed a capstone project forecasting warehouse demand with Python, using pandas and scikit-learn. I presented the findings to a panel of faculty and industry guests, which taught me how important it is to explain technical results in plain language. I enjoy that part of the work as much as the analysis itself.

I am drawn to logistics because small improvements in routing, inventory, or scheduling can have a visible impact on cost and customer satisfaction. Your company's reputation for investing in data-driven operations makes it an ideal place for me to grow my skills while contributing right away.

I am detail-oriented, curious, and comfortable working with cross-functional teams. I learn quickly, ask good questions, and take pride in producing accurate, reliable work.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support your team, and I am happy to provide work samples or references upon request.
